mechanism_narrative: A low current level of the federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active at all times without threshold activation.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is above 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic weakness, prompting risk-off behavior that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 5.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS declined from 620214 to 605282 in latest revision
failure_condition: The interaction of declining RSAFS and HOUST occurs in more than 50% of cases but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a supply shock that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL index at 270.981 implies annual inflation above 3.5%
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), INDPRO declines below 100.0 but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong current level of non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs per month signals robust labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism is active at all times without threshold activation.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth is above 100,000 but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current CPIAUCSL index at 270.981 implies annual inflation above 3.5%
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS declined in the latest revision (620214 to 605282)
failure_condition: The interaction of declining RSAFS and HOUST occurs in more than 50% of cases but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate below 2.0% year-over-year), a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current GDPC1 at 21082.134 (Q1 2021) shows strong growth
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth < 2.0%), GDPC1 growth slows below 2.0% but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
